name: AFP API
tagline: International wire news and multimedia from Agence France-Presse.
description: Content API from Agence France-Presse delivering international wire news, photos, video, and multimedia. Access is typically commercial and contract-based for publishers, media platforms, and enterprise products.

auth.details: Commercial contract access; authentication method not fully public in marketing materials—likely credentials issued after sales onboarding.

use_cases: search international wire news by topic or keyword
fetch latest AFP stories for a news aggregator
retrieve multimedia assets linked to a story
